source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("County and rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the 20 electoral divisions of Banbridge rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Twenty-one nominations were lodged, the only contest being at Skeagh, for which no result was found; the other eighteen divisions listed were uncontested. Three seats were filled by co-option. Returned unopposed.
